note: What Corner Watch asks Muse Spark to look for in a camera frame (description) and the noun phrase SAM 3.1 segments to confirm it.

high_visibility_crosswalk: crosswalks painted with wide parallel bars (zebra or ladder)
curb_extension: a sidewalk bulb-out that narrows the roadway at the corner
pedestrian_refuge: a raised island in the middle of a crossing
vehicle_in_crosswalk: a vehicle stopped on top of a crosswalk
pedestrian_outside_crosswalk: a person crossing the road away from the crosswalk
